opening.argument: The video promotes an Avalanche reward pool offering a stated 5% daily ROI, while the presenter says, “we are going to go ahead and invest in this one today” and describes a “$100 investment.” It then demonstrates participation through the Toasted AVAX page, including an entry of 1.5 AVAX for the TOAST AVAX action, and directs viewers toward “the six to one strategy” as a long-term passive-income approach. The sampled page later shows 114 TOAST and a 0.858 AVAX wallet balance, but 0.000 AVAX under Your Rewards. These facts establish promotion of an investment-pool return opportunity, while the available record does not establish an actual payout, loss, or external website behavior.
